items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] When you were on the road like that, did you ever meet Benny Goodman or Tommy Dorsey or Don Stratton? [INTERVIEWEE] No, we met Bob Cosby...

ctx.x: Jack T. Gordon? Yeah, when you first met him. No, I don't remember when I first met him, but I remember him when he was playing with Glenn Gray's Castle. I was up in Indianapolis. Ziggy Ellman and that group. And they would come over to where I was playing at the sunset. They were playing at the theater at Alta. And that's why I told you about T. Gordon and I playing out in the snow together. I don't think you ever told me. I didn't. Well, they came down there and they came into the sunset and we rushed up there…
When you were on the road like that, did you ever meet Benny Goodman or Tommy Dorsey or Don Stratton?

No, we met Bob Cosby and what was his bad cats? I don't know if you ever would remember that, but we were doing fairly good and we had enough to eat. Bob Cosby didn't and we just stopped on the road and shared what we had. They were hitting it pretty hard.
